name: @frederik91/scriptbox
description: Run untrusted, AI-written JavaScript and TypeScript in Node.js against the APIs you register: QuickJS in WebAssembly, async host calls, policy filters, limits and evidence.
author: Frederik Tegnander

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p test/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p examples/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p bench/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
